name: Korran Driftwood Seer
roles: Elder Mystic of the Tamra-Veil Wardens
notes: An elderly seer whose spirit was deeply linked to the geothermal memories of the Lingam stones. He accepted his death with peaceful dignity during the double-resonance event of Lund, leaving behind a legacy of perfect cosmic balance.
sources: Resonant Hearts: Intimate Chronicles Aboard the Kelpfang
